# Synchro Social

> Synchro Social is a done-for-you social media and content strategy agency for experts with something to teach: authors, doctors, coaches, speakers and thought leaders. Founded in 2022 by Kasper Hytonen. Based in Miami, Florida, with a fully remote team. Website: https://synchrosocial.com

Not to be confused with: synchronized swimming clubs, or any app called "Synchro". Synchro Social is a social media marketing agency.

## What we do
- We write the scripts, plan the filming, edit the videos and post them, every week, as one team that learns the client's voice.
- Every video starts with the script, written by Kasper, not with footage.
- Clients review content about 20 minutes a week and film about one day a month (around 2 hours).
- We help turn views into followers, email subscribers, program members and clients.
- No bots, no bought followers, no fake growth.

## Facts
- Founded: 2022
- Founder and CEO: Kasper Hytonen
- Headquarters: Miami, Florida, USA. Fully remote team across the US and Latin America.
- Results across all clients since 2022: 1.2B+ views and 8M+ followers grown.
- Recognition: Shortlisted, Social Media Agency of the Year, European Agency Awards 2026.
- Contact: hello@synchrosocial.com
- How to work with us: apply at https://synchrosocial.com/apply
